source.title: Challenge Track: Breaking Language Barriers: Adapting NLLB-200 and mBART for Bhilli, Gondi, Mundari, and Santali Without Source Language Proficiency
source.license: CC BY 4.0 (ACL Anthology materials published 2016 onward)
source.scope: multilingual NLP experiment including Mundari, Bhilli, Gondi and Santali; not a Munda cultural ethnography

exact_locator_candidates.locator: printed p. 106 / PDF p. 1, Section II.A, Unified Bidirectional Training
exact_locator_candidates.proposition: The author reports approximately 20,000 sentence pairs per language direction and concatenation of forward and reverse translation pairs.
exact_locator_candidates.boundary: author-reported approximate task-level quantity; not independently audited and not a Mundari-only count

exact_locator_candidates.locator: printed p. 106 / PDF p. 1, Section II.C, Language Token Extension
exact_locator_candidates.proposition: The study defines the model's custom Mundari token as __mundari_Deva__.
exact_locator_candidates.boundary: model implementation convention only; does not establish a universal Mundari script

exact_locator_candidates.locator: printed p. 107 / PDF p. 2, Section II.D, Model Architectures and Fine-Tuning
exact_locator_candidates.proposition: The paper reports NLLB-200-distilled-600M primary generation, mBART-large-50 secondary generation and 25,000 NLLB training steps.
exact_locator_candidates.boundary: paper-reported configuration; training artifacts not independently rerun

exact_locator_candidates.locator: printed p. 107 / PDF p. 2, Section III.B, Conservative Ensemble
exact_locator_candidates.proposition: The author describes replacing NLLB output with mBART output only when an under- or over-generation length-ratio trigger fires and the replacement falls within the 0.3–3.0 length-ratio window.
exact_locator_candidates.boundary: method description only; not a validated translation correctness guarantee

exact_locator_candidates.locator: printed p. 107 / PDF p. 2, Section IV, Table 1
exact_locator_candidates.proposition: The paper reports private leaderboard scores of 156.29 (mBART baseline), 174.01 (raw NLLB) and 179.49 (NLLB plus cleaning and conservative ensemble).
exact_locator_candidates.boundary: shared-task combined score across language directions; not a Mundari-only performance measure

exact_locator_candidates.proposition: The author states the work was conducted independently using Kaggle and Google Colab resources.
exact_locator_candidates.boundary: author statement; not an independently verified computation audit

notes: Exact printed-page locators checked in ACL publisher PDF; candidates are suitable for later controlled promotion only after canonical family reconciliation, source/claim schema validation, and evidence graph integration. No Munda-specific cultural or population claim is made.
